check_in_zh: 今天练了吗？在 App 里点一下打卡。

dialogue.en: Okay, retro time. Same format: what went well, what didn't, and one action item.
dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.tip: retro 是 retrospective 的简称；action item 改进项、待办
dialogue.zh: 好，回顾会时间。老格式：做得好的、没做好的、一个改进项。

dialogue.en: I'll start. What went well: the Storm cutover was way smoother than I expected.
dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.tip: way smoother 里 way 是口语加强语气，相当于 much
dialogue.zh: 我先来。做得好的：Storm 切换比我预期的顺利得多。

dialogue.en: Agreed. The runbook you wrote really helped.
dialogue.speaker: Tom
dialogue.tip: runbook 操作手册，上线必备文档
dialogue.zh: 同意。你写的 runbook 帮了大忙。

dialogue.en: Thanks! Honestly, having the rollback plan ready made all the difference.
dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.tip: made all the difference 起了决定性作用，总结成功经验的高频句
dialogue.zh: 谢谢！说实话，提前准备好回滚方案起了决定性作用。

dialogue.en: The Drova backfill ticket sat there for three days because nobody knew who owned it.
dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.tip: sat there 晾在那里，形象地表示没人动
dialogue.zh: Drova 回填的 ticket 晾了三天，因为没人知道归谁。

dialogue.en: Yeah, that was on me. I thought you were picking it up.
dialogue.speaker: Tom
dialogue.tip: that was on me 我的责任，主动认领很加分
dialogue.zh: 对，我的锅。我以为你会接。

dialogue.en: No worries, it's a process thing. Maybe we tag an owner on every ticket during planning.
dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.tip: it's a process thing 把问题归于流程，不针对人，retro 黄金句
dialogue.zh: 没关系，这是流程问题。以后 planning 时给每个 ticket 标个负责人怎么样？

dialogue.en: I like that. Let's make it an action item: assign owners in planning.
dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.zh: 我喜欢这个。记成改进项：planning 时指定负责人。

dialogue.en: One more thing, the good kind: the pairing sessions this sprint were great. More of that, please.
dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.tip: the good kind 强调是好事，先抑后扬的幽默说法
dialogue.zh: 再补充一个好的：这周的结对编程很棒，希望多来点。

dialogue.en: Noted. Alright, action items are set. Thanks, everyone.
dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.zh: 记下了。好，改进项定了，谢谢大家。

key_phrases.en: What went well: the cutover was way smoother than expected.
key_phrases.note: retro 开场讲亮点的句式
key_phrases.zh: 做得好的：切换比预期的顺利得多。

key_phrases.en: Having the rollback plan ready made all the difference.
key_phrases.note: 总结成功经验的万能句
key_phrases.zh: 提前准备好回滚方案起了决定性作用。

key_phrases.en: No worries, it's a process thing.
key_phrases.note: 不指责个人，把问题归于流程

key_phrases.en: Let's make it an action item.
key_phrases.note: retro 落到实处的关键句
肯定好的做法，简短有力

practice_zh: 跟读 5 分钟：打开 TTS，每句跟读 2 遍，练表扬和提意见时的不同语气
背诵 5 分钟：遮住英文，只看中文说出英文
复盘 5 分钟：用英文讲一遍你上周做得好的一件事和一件想改进的事
roleplay_zh: 你是 retro 的发言人：用英文讲一个你上周的真实亮点和一个改进建议，改进建议要对事不对人。
scene_zh: 每个 sprint 结束后的回顾会，聊做得好的、没做好的，并定下改进项。目标是对事不对人地复盘，让下一个 sprint 更好。
title: Sprint Retrospective
